Thank you for your submission! We really appreciate it. Like many open source projects, we ask that you sign our [Contributor License Agreement](https://cla-assistant.io/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor?pullRequest=58) before we can accept your contribution.
You have signed the CLA already but the status is still pending? Let us [recheck](https://cla-assistant.io/check/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor?pullRequest=58) it.

感谢 AI summary 功能 🙏 这是个有意思的方向，但体量较大（25 文件 / +2766）且引入新能力。按 CONTRIBUTING §3.1，新增公共能力需要先走 OpenSpec proposal——尤其 AI 功能涉及外部调用，要先把接口边界讲清楚：模型/endpoint 是 host 注入还是内置、密钥如何处理（绝不能进仓库）、离线/失败降级、是否可选插件化。另外按新合入的 GOVERNANCE.md §4，请确认该功能在项目范围内、§6.3 列出新增依赖及理由。建议先提 OpenSpec proposal 与维护者对齐，再拆分实现。

⚠️ 该 PR 目前 **CLA 未签署**，签署前无法合并。请点 PR 内 CLA 机器人的链接签署；签完并调整后维护者会重新评审。感谢理解 🙏
